House Bill 635 (AS PASSED HOUSE AND SENATE) By: Representatives Wiedower of the 121st, Frye of the 122nd, Reeves of the 99th, Persinger of the 119th, Franklin of the 160th, and others
A BILL TO BE ENTITLED AN ACT
To amend Chapter 41 of Title 43 … that has not been authorized under the provisions of this chapter to lawfully engage in contracting or perform the functions of a contractor."
SECTION 5. All laws and parts of laws in conflict with this Act are repealed.
